time_format.description: Time format used in the GUI and reports (e.g., %H:%M for 24h format)

work_hours_per_day.description: Number of working hours per day used to calculate remaining work time

email_address.description: User's email address (used as sender when smtp_username is empty)

smtp_server.description: SMTP server host to use for sending email reports

smtp_use_tls.description: Whether to use TLS for SMTP connection

smtp_use_starttls.description: Whether to use STARTTLS for SMTP connection

sender_address.description: Email address used as the 'From:' field (if empty, email_address is used)

default_recipients.description: List of email addresses to use as default recipients for daily reports

log_file.description: Custom path to the activity log file (overrides XDG data directory)

tasks_file.description: Custom path to the tasks file (overrides XDG data directory)

sentreports_file.description: Custom path to the sent reports log file (overrides XDG data directory)
